shared_elements: horizontal incised line/band (relief ground line vs. grooves around vessel rim area)
justification: A is a narrative figural relief with archers, horses, a spoked-wheel chariot and files of armed men arranged in a horizontal procession, while B is an undecorated cylindrical vessel bearing only a few faint horizontal grooves and no imagery at all. The only possible correspondence is a horizontal linear groove, which is universal and carries no iconographic weight.
